title: Ruff lint pin: bump the lint extra, [tool.ruff] required-version and requirements/lint-requirements.txt together
answers: Ruff rejects every check or format run with a required-version error after I changed the version in pyproject.toml
Where is the Ruff linter version pinned for MLflow development?
How do I upgrade the linter or formatter version used by ruff check and ruff format?
After running dev-env-setup, which lint requirements file gets installed and does it match the Ruff version?
body:
Path: The Ruff version is pinned in three places: the `lint` extra list in pyproject.toml, the `required-version` key of the `[tool.ruff]` table in pyproject.toml, and requirements/lint-requirements.txt. dev/dev-env-setup.sh installs requirements/lint-requirements.txt, so that file decides which ruff binary `ruff format --check .` and `ruff check .` run.
Rule: When changing the Ruff version, update all three pins in the same change, and refresh uv.lock without altering the cooldown exclusion. `required-version` makes Ruff refuse to run unless the installed binary matches it exactly, so the pins must agree with each other.
Symptom: Bumping only `required-version` (or only the lint extra) left the installed Ruff at the old version, and every `ruff check` or `ruff format` invocation failed because the installed binary did not match the required version.
Constraints: Applies to the Ruff pin only; pre-commit and other lint tools are pinned separately. Does not cover the seven-day cooldown exclusion, which stays as is.
applies: Changing the Ruff version or any lint tool pin in MLflow's pyproject.toml and requirements/ directory.
says: Code formatting and style checks fail because the installed linter version does not match.
The linter refuses to run any formatting checks after updating the project configuration version.
Upgrade our project code formatter and linter version across development setup files.
Running local code style validation fails immediately with a required version error.
search: Updating the Ruff linter version in MLflow requires synchronizing pyproject.toml lint extra, the [tool.ruff] required-version key, and requirements/lint-requirements.txt in a single change alongside refreshing uv.lock. Because dev/dev-env-setup.sh installs requirements/lint-requirements.txt and required-version mandates an exact match for ruff check and ruff format --check ., mismatched pins cause Ruff to refuse execution. This guidance covers only the Ruff pin without modifying pre-commit, other lint tools, or the seven-day cooldown exclusion.
